channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Josh Okogie | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Josh Okogie from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Josh Okogie
item.description:
“I really appreciated how Josh approached the game and his love for his teammates. I wish him the best. I’m sure we’ll cross paths again. He’s a great teammate, but I’m looking forward to having Nick on the team.”

Kevin Durant on Josh Okogie, Jan 16, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Josh Okogie
item.description:
Kevin Durant on Josh Okogie:

“Coach trusts him, we all trust him, so when he gets out there, we put him on the best player...he's shooting the ball well this year. So I think he's earned himself more minutes. Coach feels the same way, and hopefully he keeps building on it”

Kevin Durant on Josh Okogie, Dec 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Josh Okogie
item.description:
Bradley Beal on Josh Okogie:

“He's the energy provider. I mean, there's been games this year I've told JO, 'I need a spark. Get me going'....He continues to push the envelope for us, he challenges everybody on the defensive end to be better. You see him working, you have to work”

Bradley Beal on Josh Okogie, Dec 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Chris Paul on Josh Okogie
item.description:
“Having that type of firepower on the offensive end. For me, always trying to get guys going, sometimes you forget to look for yourself, but it’s balance. I’m figuring it out. Never really been that open, but it’s different having KD there, Book there and J-O (Josh Okogie) shooting it the way that he’s shooting it. Just going to keep trying to build.”

Chris Paul on Josh Okogie, Mar 5, 2023. Source: Arizona Republic.
